summary: Iteration 11 (final verification), frontend only, using the server build /js/toolbar.min.js. Pages tested: / and /test-modal.html, at desktop 1920x1080 and in a 390x844 touch context (has_touch, is_mobile), with speechSynthesis mocked. Each link was really hovered with page.hover and focused, and its colour was measured against the real composited background (same probes as iterations 9 and 10). ALL 3 TARGET FIXES VERIFIED. (1) black_green + yellow_orange_blue regression is FIXED: on rgb(0,128,0), all 11 links on / and both links on /test-modal give link 4.78, visited 5.14 and pointed rgb(255,246,229) 4.79 in real hover and in focus. It was 3.66 in iteration 10. (2) Order of application and transitions: tested (a) link style then theme, (b) theme then link style, and both calls in the same tick in both orders, for ivory_black, black_green and reinforcedContrasts. That makes 12 scenarios, all with 0 bad links. The CTA 'Télécharger le .xpi', which has transition-colors, is never stale. ivory_black (a) and same tick: 13.74 / 14.82 / 10.63. Order (a) gives these values because the theme imposes its own preset lightblue_orange_lightgreen through setServices, which is by design. ivory_black (b): 5.57 / 4.79 / 10.63. black_green (b) with darkblue: 4.59 / 4.50 (exactly 4.5017) / 4.79. reinforcedContrasts in all 4 orders: 5.15 / 4.56 / 7.16, with CTA real hover rgb(25,16,0) on rgb(217,101,0) = 5.21 and focus 7.16. It was 1.12 to 1.45 in iteration 10. #cplus-style-no-transition is never left in the DOM, checked after every scenario. (3) Flex/grid: there are 29 flex/grid containers on /. Going base -> word -> noModifications and base -> word -> sentence -> word -> noModifications, 0 of 184 elements moved by more than 1px, and textContent and innerText are identical. 11 flex containers with direct text (nav links, badges, CTAs, 'Guide d'installation') are still vocalized as a whole by a click, in word and sentence mode, without navigating. NON-REGRESSIONS OK: darkblue alone 5.15 / 4.56 / 7.16 (real hover on the CTA 5.21). Peach/white/dark backgrounds OK, with hover minimum 5.21. black_ivory + lightblue_orange_lightgreen: 4.56 / 4.80 / 8.88. #dark-link on test-modal: darkblue 5.01 / 5.09 / real hover 9.56; black_green 4.78 / 5.14 / 4.79; ivory_black 13.74 / 14.82 / 10.63. Full reset: 0 cplus link classes, 0 custom properties, 0 cplus style tags. 15 palette cycles (7 modes + validate + reload every 5) gave 0 pageerrors and data-values starting with 'noModifications,'. Masks: desktop 500/500 and touch 382/382, pointer-events none, elementFromPoint gives #dialog-ok, #cp filled by tap, 1 click on #dialog-ok, reset gives 0 masks. Touch: tap gives 1 utterance, an empty tap stops it, a re-tap gives 2; after the end, an empty tap then a re-tap gives 3. Accordion 1st tap reads and focuses with 0 toggles, the 2nd toggles; button 0 then 1. Mobile tooltip reads 'Tap to vocalize, tap an empty area to stop, tap again to activate'; desktop reads 'Click to vocalize, press Esc or right_click to stop.' Desktop: click reads, re-click stops, another text reads, Esc stops, right click stops. The sentence with a link is read in full. Link 1st click reads with no navigation and the 2nd goes to #ancre. Tab focus on the link reads it and Enter goes to #ancre. Accordion and button OK. The palette opens with 0 utterances. Text reinforcement: #aaa becomes #000, #ff9966 becomes rgb(204,68,0), #555 on #222 becomes #fff, #777 on rgba(0,0,0,.85) becomes #fff; page backgrounds unchanged; exact restoration. 2 NEW FINDINGS (see ui_bugs): a MEDIUM layout bug in ClickFacilite enlarge, which turns flex links into blocks in the real Easy+/Vision+/Reading+ modes, and a LOW Chromium quirk when going directly from sentence to noModifications.

ui_bugs.issue: The injected rule '.click-facilite-enlarged { display: inline-block; padding-block: 1.125rem !important }' overrides the display:flex / inline-flex of the targets (same specificity as Tailwind .flex, injected later). In the real modes Easy+ (facileplus), Vision+ and Reading+, which apply clickFacilite, 5 links on / go from 'flex' to 'block': 'Téléchargement', 'GitHub', the theme button, 'Télécharger le .xpi' and 'Guide d'installation complet'. Their SVG icon then stacks ABOVE the text, the pill-shaped CTA 'Télécharger le .xpi' is deformed, and the header grows from 105 to 181px. This is the same family of breakage as the flex/grid fix this iteration, but in a different service. Reproduce with cplus.clickFacilite.enlargeClickableElements() or by validating Easy+ in the palette. Suggested fix: apply display:inline-block only when the computed display is 'inline' (for example a separate class), and for flex/inline-flex/grid targets add only padding or min-height, never change display.

ui_bugs.component: ReadAloudService.resetBody, when going directly from 'sentence' to 'noModifications'
ui_bugs.issue: After sentence then noModifications, 5 elements shift by 5-8px and the visible spaces disappear: innerText shows 'Confort+mobile', 'non officiel.Cette' and 'viales issues'. The DOM (outerHTML) is byte-identical to the original, so this is a Blink re-layout quirk. The lost spaces are whitespace-only text nodes inside <span style='display:contents'> wrappers. Those wrappers are injected by the Emergent visual-editor instrumentation (x-excluded, data-ve-dynamic), so they exist only in this preview. A pure wrap/unwrap without Confort+ reproduces it, and toggling the parent's display (none then '') restores the space. word -> noModifications and word -> sentence -> word -> noModifications are unaffected. Low impact on real sites, but real pages can also use display:contents. Optional mitigation in resetBody: force a re-attach of the former span parents, for example parent.style.display='none'; void parent.offsetHeight; then restore the previous inline display.

action_items: MEDIUM: in click-facilite.service.ts, stop forcing display:inline-block on targets whose computed display is flex/inline-flex/grid (the nav icons stack above the text and the CTA is deformed in Easy+/Vision+/Reading+).
LOW (optional): in ReadAloudService.resetBody, force a re-layout of the unwrapped parents so whitespace inside display:contents wrappers renders again after sentence -> noModifications.
critical_code_review_comments: shiftBackground polarity guard is correct and is the cause of the black_green fix. The pointed colour on green is now rgb(255,246,229), 4.79.

refreshAdaptiveLinks sets and removes no-transition synchronously within the same task. It works because getComputedStyle forces a style flush. If applyAdaptiveLinkColor ever becomes async or chunked, the guard would need to cover the whole loop.
black_green + darkblue_orange_brown visited = 4.5017: it passes, but with no margin.

The 1s activation window after a stop (stopSpeech arms lastSpokenTarget even on Esc) means a click on a link within 1s after pressing Esc on its sentence activates the link instead of reading it. This is by design (stopSpeech comment), just noting it.
read-aloud.service.ts (739 lines) and color-contrast.service.ts (620 lines) are getting close to the 700-line split guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested checks pass; 1 new medium layout issue in ClickFacilite, 1 low preview-specific quirk)

seed_data_creation: None. The test DOM (#tz: t1, t2, t3/lk, acc, btn) is injected at runtime with /app/tests/inject.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use links_probe9.js (page.evaluate(p9, None)) for static per-state ratios and hover_probe10.js (page.evaluate(p10, indexAmong a[href])) after locator.hover() + 450ms. On test-modal, hide .ui-dialog before hovering #dark-link, otherwise the dialog intercepts the pointer. The reading-guide masks are #cplus-mask-guide__top-elt and #cplus-mask-guide__bottom-elt: they have an ID and no class, so select them with [id*=mask-guide]. For flex_layout_probe11.js, wait for document.fonts.ready + 2.5s before the baseline, otherwise the late webfont causes false layout diffs. Touch: page.context.browser.new_context(has_touch=True, is_mobile=True, viewport 390x844). To apply a mode in the palette: shadowRoot querySelector('#facileplus').click(), then 'app-select-mode button[type=submit]' visible .click(). Easy+ = darkblue_orange_brown + reinforcedContrasts + sentence + clickFacilite enlarge.
